conversation_turns_complete_check.name: conversation_turns_complete_check
conversation_turns_complete_check.value: "conversation_turns"."status" <> 'complete' OR ("conversation_turns"."ai_reply_zh" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_turns"."ai_reply_json" IS NOT NULL)

listening_exercises_ready_check.name: listening_exercises_ready_check
listening_exercises_ready_check.value: "listening_exercises"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("listening_exercises"."content_json" IS NOT NULL AND "listening_exercises"."source" IS NOT NULL)

sessions_kind_edition_check.name: sessions_kind_edition_check
sessions_kind_edition_check.value: ("sessions"."kind" = 'hsk' AND "sessions"."edition_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sessions"."kind" = 'free_chat' AND "sessions"."edition_id" IS NULL)
